task: Create and verify a shadow successor of the current temporal execution fabric that persists temporal ticks and recurrent execution memory as one atomic local checkpoint. Destroy the original runtime object, reconstruct a fresh runtime from the checkpoint, and prove that completed stage outcomes, attempted-stage history, temporal predecessor continuity, and the next planning decision survive restart. A previously failed stage must not be selected again after restoration. Tampered memory or cross-layer continuity must fail closed.
success_conditions: one checkpoint contains temporal state and recurrent memory state
checkpoint written atomically to a local durable file
original runtime is destroyed before restore
fresh runtime restores exact logical tick
fresh runtime restores recurrent sequence and episode count
thinking memory feedback remains active after restart
decision after restart equals decision before restart
failed stage is not selected again after restart
first post-restart tick is monotonic and preserves same-stream predecessor
